subject: Deal lifelines & forecast triage - Novus Platform
messages:
From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com, tessa.morgan@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 05 Apr 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Deal lifelines & forecast triage - Novus Platform

Team —

Quick triage: Novus is scheduled for final exec review in two weeks and finance wants a 'lifelines' view for the forecast. I ran a quick snapshot and there are a couple of thin stages that could move us from 0.6x to ~0.9x coverage if we tighten commit discipline.

Ask: can each of you confirm the following by EOD Monday (04/08)?
- Stage accuracy: update each Novus-related opportunity stage to reflect the most recent POC signals (notes in HubSpot).
- Close probability: confirm whether probability should stay as-is or be adjusted (if moving to commit, include why).
- Blockers: list any procurement/security asks that could delay sign.

I've attached a lightweight spreadsheet (novus-deal-lifelines.xlsx) with my suggested lifelines and a one-line rationale per deal. Marcus: can you validate the timelines on the three midmarket seats? Tessa: please confirm whether finance will accept our current billing term or needs to push for annual billing to hit ARR model. Laura: can you confirm whether we should surface a 10% early-buy incentive to get the exec review scheduled?

Goal: close any small, fast unblockers to improve pipe-to-quota on the weekly forecast refresh. If we can't move anything, we'll roll a contingency ask to the CSM to push for procurement alignment.

Thanks — short replies welcome.

— Lukas
Lukas Meyer | Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
Direct: (415) 555-0123

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: lukas.meyer@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com, tessa.morgan@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 05 Apr 2029 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Deal lifelines & forecast triage - Novus Platform

Lukas / team —

Saw this and did a quick pass. Notes in the spreadsheet lines 4–6:
- Opportunity Novus-ENG-3: buyer signoff week of 4/15 looks realistic; procurement asked for SOC 2 in writing but said it won't block the contract if we provide evidence by 4/12.
- Opportunity Novus-PLAT-1: POC completed; legal counters on indemnity language are outstanding (expected 3 business days once we return redlines).
- Opportunity Novus-ADDON-2: low-dollar upsell; I can call the champion and ask for verbal confirmation this week.

I can own the call to the champion and push for the early-buy incentive confirmation (fine to offer 8–10% for a signed LOE by 4/12).

Attaching my quick notes: novus-mop-v1.pdf (summary of procurement asks).

— Marcus
Marcus Lin | Account Executive, Midmarket
Redwood Inference

From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
To: Casey Nguyen <casey@novusplatform.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com, tessa.morgan@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 06 Apr 2029 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Deal lifelines & forecast triage - Novus Platform

Casey —

Thanks again for the time on the call yesterday. Per our discussion, we put together a concise "lifelines" view so your execs can see exactly which items move the needle for a mid-April decision. Attached is a one-page MOP + the spreadsheet Marcus and I referenced.

Proposed mutual action items:
1) Procurement: Novus to confirm whether SOC 2 evidence provided via our secure drive satisfies legal; Redwood to provide SOC 2 attest on or before 4/12.
2) Commercial: Novus to commit to an exec review week of 4/15–4/19; Redwood to surface a limited-time 8% early-buy credit for any agreements signed by 4/12.
3) Legal: Novus to return any outstanding redlines by 4/10; Redwood to accept standard carve language for data residency where feasible.

If those three items are green, Marcus and I believe we can get this over the finish line without opening up additional discounts. Would you be able to confirm procurement's view and whether an exec slot on 4/16 would work?

Short note is fine — open to jump on 15 minutes if helpful.

Best —
Lukas

From: Casey Nguyen <casey@novusplatform.com>
To: lukas.meyer@redwood.com
Cc: procure@novusplatform.com
Date: Sun, 07 Apr 2029 16:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Deal lifelines & forecast triage - Novus Platform

Lukas —

Appreciate the clear lifelines doc. Quick answers from procurement:
- SOC 2: receipt of the attestation file will be sufficient for the initial procurement review; final contract requires a clause about evidence availability on request.
- Legal: they want to keep one indemnity sentence that we redlined; expect to return a short redline by 4/09.
- Exec slot: 4/16 at 10:00 PT works for our team.

One ask: any chance you can confirm whether Redwood can push billing to Net 60 for midmarket this deal? Our finance team prefers Net 60 vs. Net 30. If not, we may need to pivot to an annual prepay to satisfy internal ARR pacing.

I'll loop procurement and legal on your MOP and confirm once they review the attachments.

Thanks —
Casey Nguyen
Head of Platform Partnerships
Novus Platform
